method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Biosecurity Act 2015, Compilation No. 21, compilation date 16 September 2026 (register id C2026C00403), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2015A00061.txt (retrieved 2026-10-13); with Regulatory Powers (Standard Provisions) Act 2014 Compilation No. 4 (20 March 2024) ss 82(5), 84(2), 103(5). The goods determinations (ss 173, 174, 182), the Biosecurity Regulation 2016, the approved form of the incoming passenger declaration and the indexed penalty unit are not deposited and are inputs.

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: The incoming traveller: commencement (s 2); biosecurity control of goods brought in (ss 119, 162); the incoming passenger declaration and travel documents (s 196) and entry requirements (s 196C); questions from a biosecurity officer (s 126) and self-incrimination (s 635); prohibited, suspended and conditionally non-prohibited goods (ss 173, 174, 182) as inputs; forfeiture (s 628) and destruction (ss 131, 136); contraventions for bringing goods in (ss 185(1)-(3), 186(1)-(3), (7), 186A); false or misleading information (s 532); maximum penalties; infringement notices (ss 523, 524) and their payment period; no civil penalty after a conviction for the same conduct (s 520(1)); visa cancellation (not in this Act). Out: human biosecurity, conveyances, permits, ss 185(4)-(5), 186(4)-(5), 188, other biosecurity measures, Criminal Code ss 137.1-137.2.
